recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中央的嗜中性白血球細胞質內有數顆大小不一、圓形且與細胞核同色的深紫色小顆粒，排列在核旁，形態像紅血球中的 Howell-Jolly body，屬於嗜中性球內 Howell-Jolly body 樣包涵物。
features: Neutrophil containing several (about 4-5) small, round, dense dark purple cytoplasmic inclusions
Inclusions stain like nuclear chromatin and are well-circumscribed, varying slightly in size
Host neutrophil nucleus lobulated/clumped with pink cytoplasm
A second round leukocyte with dense clumped chromatin below, without clear inclusions
Background crenated red cells (echinocytes, likely artifactual) with stacked red cells in thicker areas; normal-appearing platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil containing several small, round, sharply defined cytoplasmic inclusions that stain dark purple, similar to nuclear chromatin, located adjacent to the nucleus. These resemble Howell-Jolly bodies and are distinct from pale blue Dohle bodies or coarse toxic granules. A second leukocyte in the field lacks such inclusions. The background shows crenated red cells and red cell stacking in thicker areas, with platelets present. Findings are consistent with Howell-Jolly body-like inclusions in neutrophils, which are associated with immunosuppressive or cytotoxic drugs (e.g., mycophenolate, chemotherapy), HIV infection or transplantation.

ddx.vs: Dohle bodies are pale blue-grey, irregular, peripheral cytoplasmic patches of rough ER, not dense round purple chromatin-like dots.
Morulae are stippled, mulberry-like clusters of basophilic organisms, larger and granular rather than smooth homogeneous round dots.
Platelets show granular purple centers with pale periphery and lie in a different focal plane, whereas these inclusions are uniformly dense and within the cytoplasm.
Apoptotic cells show complete nuclear pyknosis with multiple condensed fragments replacing the nucleus, whereas here the lobulated nucleus remains intact.
